1.4 References to "INR" or "₹" are to Indian Rupees, the lawful currency of the Republic of India.

---

**2. TERM AND COMMENCEMENT**

2.1 This Agreement shall be deemed to have commenced and become effective on the 1st day of April 2024 (the "Commencement Date"), and shall remain in full force and effect for a period of three (3) years from the Commencement Date, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement (the "Initial Term").

2.3 The Parties agree that a performance review meeting shall be held in the month of June 2024 to review the initial performance of the Service Provider under this Agreement.

---

**3. SCOPE OF SERVICES**

3.1 The Service Provider shall provide the following energy management services at the Premises (collectively, the "Services"):
(a) Operation, monitoring, and maintenance of the HVAC systems, including the chiller plant, air handling units, and ventilation systems.
(b) Operation, monitoring, and maintenance of the BMS, including software updates, sensor calibration, and alarm management.
(c) Energy auditing, data analysis, and reporting to identify opportunities for energy efficiency improvements.
(d) Management of the electrical infrastructure, including distribution panels, transformers, and backup generators, to the extent required for energy management.
(e) Coordination with the Client's facilities management team on all matters relating to energy consumption and equipment operation.
(f) Providing monthly energy consumption reports and quarterly performance summaries to the Client.

3.2 The Services shall be provided during the working hours of the Premises, which are from 09:00 hours to 18:00 hours, Monday through Saturday. Emergency call-out support shall be available 24x7.

3.3 Any services not expressly covered under this Clause 3 but requested by the Client shall be provided by the Service Provider on a time-and-material basis, subject to the Client's prior written approval of the estimated charges.

3.4 The Service Provider shall designate a dedicated Account Manager who shall be the primary point of contact for the Client. The Account Manager shall be available for a review meeting with the Client's representatives on the first Business Day of each Month.

---

**4. CHARGES AND PAYMENT**

4.1 In consideration of the provision of the Services, the Client shall pay the Service Provider the Charges as set out in Annexure A.

4.2 The Charges shall be payable monthly in arrears, within thirty (30) days of receipt of a valid invoice from the Service Provider.

4.3 All invoices shall be submitted by the Service Provider on or before the fifth (5th) Business Day of the Month following the Month in which the Services were rendered.
